author: Simon Palmer
text: Hi Imy, I’ve been Type 2 diabetic for 3yrs. In general in the UK, CGMs are free on the NHS only if you are being treated with injected insulin. Both Dexcom and Abbot offer free trials. I’ve recently switched to Dexcom One+. Both Dexcom and Freestyle Libre work ok, BUT Dexcom offer a subscription for £75pm, Libre 2 recently replaced by by Libre 3 at £150pm !!!! For me the CGM was a game changer helping me understand in detail the impact of types of food on my personal blood glucose. Note that Dexcom also actively help customers determine if they are entitled to be zero rate VAT on their CGMs. I got no help on this from Abbott. Hope that helps. Good luck !
